$comment: Tremco (sealants and coatings, Tremco Construction Products) product pages time out for every page fetch from this network, including AvalAI's page fetch. So the site uses the default engine (APP_DEFAULT_ENGINE, ai-crawler-avalai on this instance) with ai_fetch web_search; the shop is never contacted and the values are unverified (AI_UNVERIFIED). The data sheet values (movement capability, skin time, cure time) come from the search model only. Engines tried on 2026-11-19: http and ai_fetch http: FETCH_TIMEOUT; browser: FETCH_TIMEOUT; ai_fetch browser: FETCH_TIMEOUT; web_search: success (6 specs, 7 features, 563+330 tokens). Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key.
